headline: AMD achieves 'largest and most profitable' quarter in history
summary: AMD reported its largest and most profitable quarter ever in Q3 2026. Quarterly revenue hit a record $13.4 billion. The company anticipates hitting $17 billion next quarter, driven by data center growth.

headline: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake revealed for Switch 2
summary: Nintendo is launching a Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. This highly anticipated remake arrives 28 years after the original N64 release. It features a significantly more realistic visual style.

headline: Nexus Mods mandates AI disclosure for new mod uploads
summary: PC gaming modding site Nexus Mods now requires mandatory AI disclosures for new mod uploads. Authors must declare if AI was used in their creations. This move addresses the platform's stance on AI-generated content.

headline: Analyst addresses ongoing questions about an 'AI bubble' burst
summary: The author is frequently asked about the potential bursting of an AI bubble. They admit that predicting such an event is impossible. If they knew, they'd make a life-changing market bet.

headline: Talix 20,000mAh Power Bank with 190W drops to $29.99
summary: The Talix 20,000mAh Power Bank is now available for $29.99. It boasts a powerful 190W total output for fast charging. This early Black Friday deal can charge devices like the MacBook Pro 16" M5.

headline: Marvel's VisionQuest Episode 7 Review: 'Immolation' delivers compelling penultimate episode
summary: Episode 7 of Marvel's VisionQuest, 'Immolation,' has received a positive review. Paul Bettany's performance is highlighted as compelling. The episode marks the penultimate entry in the series.

headline: James Bond Casting History: How Media Covered Past 007 Reveals
summary: November 3 marks 65 years since Sean Connery was cast as the first James Bond. The article explores historical media reactions to past 007 reveals. It shows that public complaints about Bond casting are not new.

headline: SCUF Gaming's Early Black Friday Sale offers up to 25% off controllers
summary: SCUF Gaming is holding an early Black Friday sale. Customers can save up to 25% on professional-grade controllers. Deals apply to both Xbox and PC controllers.

headline: Democrats shatter Trump's political map on historic election night
summary: Democrats achieved significant victories, overturning expected battlegrounds. Two key Senate races turned into clear Democratic wins. The results signify a major shift in the political landscape.

headline: Visualizing America's midterm election results with maps and charts
summary: Interactive maps and charts illustrate the voting patterns in the US midterm elections. The article provides a visual breakdown of results across the country. It offers a comprehensive overview of how America voted.

headline: Key moments from a night of midterm election firsts
summary: Democrats gained control of Congress during Donald Trump's presidency. The election night featured several historic 'firsts.' These pivotal moments sparked celebration among Democrats.

headline: James Talarico makes history, wins Texas Senate seat for Democrats
summary: James Talarico became the first Democrat to win a Texas Senate seat since 1988. An expert called the Democratic wins in Texas a 'bloodbath.' This victory marks a historic shift in the state's political landscape.
